notes: Access tier 1 (curl) confirmed no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow, then fetched static HTML, sitemap.xml (8 shards, ~14.5k URLs) and homepage/mega-menu nav for christmas/advent/easter/halloween/valentine/new-year/thanksgiving/black-friday/mother's-day/father's-day terms in English and German. Connox's category PLPs render their product grid and item-count toolbar client-side (React islands over a jQuery/Magento-style shell; static HTML has zero product markup), so qty was read with Playwright (network-idle render) from the page's own 'N Items sorted by:' toolbar total, cross-checked against the 'N of N items seen' full-scroll confirmation where shown. Only Christmas/Advent-season categories exist as genuine PLPs; no Easter, Halloween, Valentine's Day, New Year, Thanksgiving, Black Friday, or Mother's/Father's Day category pages exist anywhere in the site taxonomy or sitemap - all matches for those terms were individual product-detail pages (a Christmas-themed hand soap, an Easter plate, New Year napkins, etc.), not categories. Two duplicate URL pairs collapsed per the overlap rule: /categories/accessories/home-decor/advent-calendars.html and /categories/accessories/home-decor/christmas.html both 301/canonical to the two rows kept below (identical page, identical count). /categories/holiday-decoration.html (no sub-slug) and /categories/seasonal/advent-season.html both canonicalize to the generic /categories/home-decor.html catch-all, not a seasonal page, so were excluded. /categories/gift-vouchers/christmas-gift-voucher.html is a single-product PDP (one voucher design, 'Add to shopping cart'), not a category - excluded. Connox is a Danish/Scandi design-object concept store; its Christmas range is exactly the kind of thin-but-real gift/decor range the brief flags checking for, and it turned out to be real (7 genuine sub-categories).
